info.name: AINP-NF API
info.description:
REST API for the AINP-Natural Farming Project Management System (ICAR-IIFSR).

**Generated file: do not edit by hand.** Run `npm run postman` in icar-nf-backend after changing routes or DTOs.

### Getting started
1. Set the `loginEmail` and `loginPassword` collection variables (for example, the seeded Super Administrator from `.env`).
2. Run **Auth → Sign in**. The API returns an httpOnly `nf_session` cookie; Postman stores it and sends it with every later request automatically.
3. **Create** requests save the new record's id in a variable (e.g. `centreId`), which **Get** and **Update** requests then use.

### Conventions
- Success: `{ "success": true, "data": …, "meta"? }`. Failure: `{ "success": false, "error": { "code", "message", "details"?, "requestId" } }`.
- Every response has an `X-Request-Id` header; quote it when reporting a problem so it can be found in the server logs.
- Each request's description lists who may call it and every field with its validation rules.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Sign in and out. The session is an httpOnly cookie that Postman stores and resends.

request.description:
Checks the email and password and sets the httpOnly session cookie. Limited to 10 failed attempts per 15 minutes per IP.

**Access:** public (no sign-in needed)

**Endpoint:** `POST /api/v1/auth/login`

**Body**

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string | yes | email; pattern `^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_'+\-]+\.)*[A-Za-z0-9_'+\-]*[A-Za-z0-9_+-]@(?:[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\-]*\.)+[A-Za-z]{2,}$` |  |
| `password` | string | yes | 1–128 chars |  |

Unknown fields are rejected.

Clears the session cookie. Returns 204.

**Access:** public (no sign-in needed)

**Endpoint:** `POST /api/v1/auth/logout`

Returns the signed-in user.

**Access:** any signed-in user

**Endpoint:** `GET /api/v1/auth/me`

item.name: Users
item.description: User accounts. Needs `users.manage`; each role can only create the roles it is allowed to (only the PCU and Super Administrator create PI and data-entry accounts).

query.description: string · Sort by one of: name, email, roleId, createdAt (prefix with - for descending)

request.description:
**Access:** signed in, and the role needs `users.manage`

**Endpoint:** `GET /api/v1/users`

**Query parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | integer | no | min 1; default `1` |  |
| `limit` | integer | no | min 1; max 100; default `20` |  |
| `sort` | string | no | — | Sort by one of: name, email, roleId, createdAt (prefix with - for descending) |
| `roleId` | string | no | one of `superadmin`, `pc`, `finance`, `adminOfficer`, `reviewer`, `pi`, `dataEntry`, `admin` |  |
| `centreId` | string | no | ObjectId |  |
| `isActive` | string | no | — | true or false |

**Access:** signed in, and the role needs `users.manage`

**Endpoint:** `GET /api/v1/users/:id`

exec: // Remember the new user so "Get", "Update" and other requests can use it.

request.description:
**Access:** signed in, and the role needs `users.manage`

**Endpoint:** `POST /api/v1/users`

**Body**

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | 2–120 chars |  |
| `email` | string | yes | email; pattern `^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_'+\-]+\.)*[A-Za-z0-9_'+\-]*[A-Za-z0-9_+-]@(?:[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9\-]*\.)+[A-Za-z]{2,}$` |  |
| `password` | string | yes | 10–128 chars | At least 10 characters with a letter and a digit |
| `roleId` | string | yes | one of `superadmin`, `pc`, `finance`, `adminOfficer`, `reviewer`, `pi`, `dataEntry`, `admin` |  |
| `centreId` | string | no | ObjectId; default `null`; nullable | Required for pi and dataEntry; ignored for national roles |
| `designation` | string | no | 0–120 chars |  |

Unknown fields are rejected.

item.name: Centres
item.description: Network and voluntary centres. Only the PCU and Super Administrator create or edit them (`centres.manage`). Everyone signed in can read them; PI and data-entry users see only their own centre.

query.description: string · Sort by one of: code, name, state, createdAt (prefix with - for descending)
string · 0–100 chars · Matches name, code or host

request.description:
**Access:** any signed-in user

**Endpoint:** `GET /api/v1/centres`

**Query parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | integer | no | min 1; default `1` |  |
| `limit` | integer | no | min 1; max 100; default `20` |  |
| `sort` | string | no | — | Sort by one of: code, name, state, createdAt (prefix with - for descending) |
| `search` | string | no | 0–100 chars | Matches name, code or host |
| `state` | string | no | 0–60 chars |  |
| `type` | string | no | one of `Network Centre`, `Voluntary Centre` |  |
| `isActive` | string | no | — | true or false |

exec: // Remember the new centre so "Get", "Update" and other requests can use it.

body.raw:
{
  "code": "KNP",
  "name": "Kanpur",
  "host": "CSA University of Agriculture & Technology",
  "state": "Uttar Pradesh",
  "type": "Network Centre"
}

request.description:
**Access:** signed in, and the role needs `centres.manage`

**Endpoint:** `POST /api/v1/centres`

**Body**

| Field | Type | Required | Rules | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | yes | pattern `^[A-Za-z]{2,10}$` | Short unique code; stored in upper case |
| `name` | string | yes | 2–120 chars |  |
| `host` | string | yes | 2–200 chars | Host institution |
| `state` | string | yes | 2–60 chars |  |
| `type` | string | no | one of `Network Centre`, `Voluntary Centre`; default `"Network Centre"` |  |

Unknown fields are rejected.

body.raw:
{
  "code": "KNP",
  "name": "Kanpur",
  "host": "CSA University of Agriculture & Technology",
  "state": "Uttar Pradesh",
  "type": "Network Centre",
  "isActive": true
}
